title: NehaAnalyzes/llm-mental-health-assistant
summary: 基于RAG的心理健康助手，利用向量嵌入进行语义文档检索，并通过LangChain、ChromaDB和Gemini LLM生成基于上下文的响应。采用Streamlit构建对话界面，提供心理健康咨询。，基于模型推理的架构
description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) based mental health assistant that performs semantic document retrieval using vector embeddings and generates grounded, context-aware responses via a conversational Streamlit interface. Built with LangChain, ChromaDB, and Gemini LLM.
